data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Mens Rea (犯罪意图) 与 Malice (恶意)
正确答案：B 不应维持定罪。因为法官的指示错误地描述了必要的心理状态（Mens Rea）。
⚖️ 核心法律分析
1. 恶意 (Malice) 的定义

在普通法刑法中，"Malicious Damage to Property"（恶意损害财物罪）属于 Malice Crime（恶意犯罪）。这里的 "Malice" 并不要求被告对受害者怀有仇恨，而是要求证明以下两种心理状态之一：

  • Intent (故意/明知)： 实际上确定行为会导致损害。
  • Recklessness (鲁莽)： 有意识地忽视了一个重大且不合理的风险（Conscious disregard of a substantial and unjustifiable risk）。
2. 本案中的错误指示

法官告诉陪审团：只要认定被告犯有盗窃罪（Larceny），且损害是盗窃的结果，就足以定罪。

错误原因： 这个指示将“盗窃的意图”自动转化为“损害财物的恶意”。然而：

  • 被告偷车时并不知道刹车失灵。
  • 因此，他既没有“故意”撞毁商店，也没有“鲁莽”地忽视撞毁商店的风险（因为他不知道风险存在）。

法官的指示实际上创造了一种不存在的“严格责任”或错误的“意图转移”，剥夺了陪审团判断被告是否具有损害财物之 Mens Rea 的权利。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误 关于 Double Jeopardy (一事不再理)：
根据 Blockburger 测试，如果两个罪名各自包含对方所不具备的构成要件（Element），则不违反双重危险原则。
  • Larceny 需要“带走他人财物”；
  • Malicious Damage 需要“物理损害财物”。
两者要素不同，可以分别定罪。
选项 C 错误 关于 Felony (重罪)：
虽然有 "Felony Murder"（重罪谋杀）规则，但法律中不存在通用的 "Felony Damage" 规则。仅仅因为在实施重罪过程中造成了损害，并不自动满足恶意损害财物罪的心理要件。
选项 D 错误 关于意图转移：
偷车的意图 (Specific Intent to steal) 不能填补恶意损害财物罪所需的 Malice。这是两种不同的心理状态，针对的是不同的危害结果。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

遇到涉及 Jury Instruction (陪审团指示) 的题目时，务必检查指示是否准确反映了该罪名的 Mens Rea (心理状态) 要求。

如果法官的指示将“因果关系”（结果是由行为导致的）直接等同于“犯罪意图”，通常是错误的指示。必须证明被告对特定的危害结果具备相应的心理状态。

MBE Criminal Law Review

questions.question:
A mechanic advised a delivery driver to replace the hitch on the driver's semi-truck during a routine inspection. The mechanic warned that if the hitch was not replaced, the trailer could disconnect from the semi-truck if driven at speeds exceeding 50 miles per hour. Wanting to avoid the additional cost, the driver opted against replacing the hitch and left the mechanic's shop. Late for a delivery, the driver entered a busy highway and accelerated to 55 miles per hour. Soon thereafter, the trailer disconnected from the semi-truck and obstructed three lanes of traffic.
The driver was charged with the violation of a state statute that makes it a crime for a person who, "having no legal privilege to do so, obstructs any highway or other public passage, whether alone or with others." The statute further provides that a person who commits the offense shall be punished by no more than six months' confinement. The jurisdiction has eliminated strict liability for crimes that carry the possibility of confinement, but the statute does not state a requisite mental state.
In a jurisdiction that has adopted the Model Penal Code approach with respect to mens rea, can the driver be convicted under the statute?

choices.a: No, because at minimum, the driver must have acted knowingly.
choices.b: No, because the driver's conduct was merely negligent.
choices.c: Yes, because at minimum, the driver's conduct was reckless.
choices.d: Yes, because the driver acted purposely.

data.questionStem:
Q85100

A mechanic advised a delivery driver to replace the hitch on the driver's semi-truck during a routine inspection. The mechanic warned that if the hitch was not replaced, the trailer could disconnect from the semi-truck if driven at speeds exceeding 50 miles per hour. Wanting to avoid the additional cost, the driver opted against replacing the hitch and left the mechanic's shop. Late for a delivery, the driver entered a busy highway and accelerated to 55 miles per hour. Soon thereafter, the trailer disconnected from the semi-truck and obstructed three lanes of traffic.

The driver was charged with the violation of a state statute that makes it a crime for a person who, "having no legal privilege to do so, obstructs any highway or other public passage, whether alone or with others." The statute further provides that a person who commits the offense shall be punished by no more than six months' confinement. The jurisdiction has eliminated strict liability for crimes that carry the possibility of confinement, but the statute does not state a requisite mental state.

In a jurisdiction that has adopted the Model Penal Code approach with respect to mens rea, can the driver be convicted under the statute?

一名机修工在例行检查中，建议一位货车司机更换其半挂卡车上的挂钩。机修工警告说，如果不更换挂钩，当车速超过每小时50英里时，拖车可能会与半挂卡车脱离。为了避免额外的费用，司机选择不更换挂钩，并离开了机修店。由于送货迟到，司机驶入一条繁忙的高速公路，并加速到每小时55英里。不久之后，拖车与半挂卡车脱离，并堵塞了三条车道。

司机被指控违反了一项州法规，该法规将以下行为定为犯罪：“在没有合法特权的情况下，单独或与他人共同妨碍任何高速公路或其他公共通道。”该法规进一步规定，犯此罪者应被处以不超过六个月的监禁。该司法管辖区已经废除了对可能判处监禁的犯罪适用严格责任，但该法规并未规定必要的犯罪意图（mental state）。

在一个就犯罪意图（mens rea）采纳了《模范刑法典》（Model Penal Code）方法的司法管辖区，该司机是否可以根据该法规被定罪？
options:
A. No, because at minimum, the driver must have acted knowingly.
不可以，因为司机至少必须是明知地（knowingly）行为。

B. No, because the driver's conduct was merely negligent.
不可以，因为司机的行为仅仅是过失（negligent）。

C. Yes, because at minimum, the driver's conduct was reckless.
可以，因为司机的行为至少是鲁莽的（reckless）。

D. Yes, because the driver acted purposely.
可以，因为司机是故意（purposely）行为的。
data.explanation:
Hierarchy of culpable mental states

(Model Penal Code)
PurposelyDefendant acts with conscious objective to: engage in conduct or cause particular result
KnowinglyDefendant acts with: awareness that conduct is of nature required by crime or practical certainty that conduct will cause particular result
RecklesslyDefendant acts with: conscious disregard of substantial & unjustifiable risk and risk amounts to gross deviation from law-abiding citizen's standard of conduct
NegligentlyDefendant: should be aware of substantial & unjustifiable risk and risk amounts to gross deviation from reasonable person's standard of care
Under the Model Penal Code, when a statute fails to include a requisite mental state, the prosecution must prove that the defendant acted at least recklessly to obtain a conviction (Choice A). This means that a showing of either a purposeful or knowing mental state will also suffice to obtain a conviction - since those are higher levels of culpability than recklessness. However, proof that the defendant merely acted negligently will not suffice since negligence is a lower level of culpability than recklessness.

Here, the driver was aware that driving at speeds exceeding 50 miles per hour could cause his trailer to detach. The driver consciously disregarded that risk by driving at 55 miles per hour, resulting in the trailer detaching and obstructing the highway. This means that his conduct exceeded criminal negligence and was, at a minimum, reckless (Choice B). Accordingly, the driver can be convicted under the statute.

(Choice D) Under the Model Penal Code, a purposeful mental state involves a conscious objective to engage in conduct or cause a particular result. Here, there are no facts to indicate that the driver acted with the objective of obstructing the highway. Nevertheless, the driver can be convicted under the statute because he acted recklessly.

Educational objective: Under the Model Penal Code, when a statute fails to include a requisite mental state, the prosecution must prove that the defendant acted at least recklessly to obtain a conviction.

选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 6%，C选项 77%（正确选项），D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

可归责的心理状态层级

(Model Penal Code)
故意（Purposely）被告人的行为具有以下自觉目的：实施某种行为或导致特定结果
明知（Knowingly）被告人的行为具有以下意识：其行为具有犯罪所要求的性质或其行为基本上确定会导致特定结果
鲁莽（Recklessly）被告人的行为具有以下特征：有意识地漠视重大且无理的风险并且该风险严重偏离守法公民的行为标准
过失（Negligently）被告人：应当意识到重大且无理的风险并且该风险严重偏离理性人的注意标准
根据《模范刑法典》（Model Penal Code），当法规未包含必要的犯罪意图时，控方必须证明被告的行为至少达到了鲁莽（recklessly）的程度才能定罪（选项A）。这意味着，证明故意（purposeful）或明知（knowing）的心理状态也足以定罪——因为这些是比鲁莽（recklessness）更高层级的可归责性。然而，证明被告的行为仅仅是过失（negligently）则不足以定罪，因为过失是比鲁莽（recklessness）更低层级的可归责性。

在本案中，司机意识到以超过每小时50英里的速度行驶可能会导致其拖车脱落。司机以每小时55英里的速度行驶，有意识地漠视了该风险，导致拖车脱落并妨碍了高速公路。这意味着他的行为超越了刑事过失，至少是鲁莽的（选项B）。因此，该司机可以根据该法规被定罪。

（选项D）根据《模范刑法典》（Model Penal Code），故意（purposeful）的心理状态涉及实施某种行为或导致特定结果的自觉目的。在本案中，没有事实表明司机的行为具有妨碍高速公路的目的。尽管如此，由于司机的行为是鲁莽的，他仍可根据该法规被定罪。

教学目的：根据《模范刑法典》（Model Penal Code），当法规未包含必要的犯罪意图时，控方必须证明被告的行为至少达到了鲁莽（recklessly）的程度才能定罪。

References

Model Penal Code § 2.02(3) (establishing minimum requisite mental state when not indicated in statute).

data.htmlContent:
核心考点：MPC 默认犯罪意图

本题考察的是《模范刑法典》（Model Penal Code, MPC）中关于法规未规定犯罪意图（Mens Rea）时的默认规则。

⚖️ 法律规则 (MPC § 2.02(3)):
如果刑法条文本身没有规定具体的犯罪意图（Mental State），且该罪行不是严格责任（Strict Liability）犯罪，则控方必须证明被告的行为至少达到了 鲁莽 (Recklessness) 的程度。

这意味着：仅仅证明“过失”（Negligence）是不够的，必须证明被告有“鲁莽”、“明知”（Knowingly）或“故意”（Purposely）的心态。

MPC 心理状态层级

理解层级是解题关键（从高到低）：

层级 英文术语 定义关键词
1. 故意 Purposely 自觉目的 (Conscious object)
2. 明知 Knowingly 几乎确定 (Practically certain)
3. 鲁莽 Recklessly 有意识地漠视 (Conscious disregard) ★默认最低标准
4. 过失 Negligently 应当意识到 (Should be aware)

本案分析逻辑

1. 确定法律标准：
题目指出该司法管辖区采用 MPC 且已废除监禁刑的严格责任。法规未写明意图，因此默认标准是鲁莽（Recklessness）。

2. 分析被告行为：

  • 知情：机修工明确警告司机，超过50英里/小时会导致拖车脱落。
  • 漠视：司机为了省钱不修，且为了赶时间开到了55英里/小时。
  • 结论：司机实际上意识到了风险（Subjective Awareness），却有意识地漠视了该风险（Conscious Disregard）。

✅ 结论：司机的行为符合“鲁莽”的定义。因为法规的最低要求是“鲁莽”，所以他可以被定罪。

为什么选 C 排除其他？

❌ 选项 A (Knowingly) 错误：
虽然“明知”足以定罪，但它不是最低要求。MPC 的默认最低门槛是鲁莽。控方不需要证明司机“确定”车会坏，只需证明他漠视了风险。

❌ 选项 B (Negligently) 错误：
第一，MPC 默认规则下，仅有过失（Negligence）通常不足以构成犯罪。第二，本案中司机已经被警告，他实际上“知道”风险，这超越了“应当知道”的过失范畴，属于鲁莽。

❌ 选项 D (Purposely) 错误：
司机并没有“想要”堵塞交通的自觉目的（Conscious Objective）。他是为了赶时间，而不是为了犯罪。

💡 MBE 备考锦囊

遇到 MPC 题目中法规“沉默”（未提及意图）的情况：

  1. 首先检查是否为严格责任（通常涉及公共福利、轻微处罚）。题目中明确说“废除了严格责任”，排除此项。
  2. 记住口诀：MPC Silence = Recklessness。
  3. 区分鲁莽与过失的关键点：
    • 鲁莽 = 实际上知道风险但不管 (Subjective)。
    • 过失 = 不知道风险，但正常人应该知道 (Objective)。
© MBE Criminal Law Review

questions.question:
A defendant is charged with an offense under a statute that provides as follows: "Any person who, while intoxicated, appears in any public place and manifests a drunken condition by obstreperous or indecent conduct is guilty of a misdemeanor."
At trial, the evidence shows that the defendant was intoxicated when police officers burst into his house and arrested him pursuant to a valid warrant. It was a cold night, and the officers hustled the defendant out of his house without giving him time to get his coat. The defendant became angry and obstreperous when the officers refused to let him go back into the house to retrieve his coat. The officers left him handcuffed outside in the street, waiting for a special squad car to arrive. The arrest warrant was later vacated.
Can the defendant properly be convicted of violating the statute?

choices.a: No, because the defendant's claim of mistreatment is valid.
choices.b: No, because the statute requires proof of a voluntary appearance in a public place.
choices.c: Yes, because the defendant voluntarily became intoxicated.
choices.d: Yes, because the defendant voluntarily behaved in an obstreperous manner.

data.questionStem:
Q85111

A defendant is charged with an offense under a statute that provides as follows: "Any person who, while intoxicated, appears in any public place and manifests a drunken condition by obstreperous or indecent conduct is guilty of a misdemeanor."

At trial, the evidence shows that the defendant was intoxicated when police officers burst into his house and arrested him pursuant to a valid warrant. It was a cold night, and the officers hustled the defendant out of his house without giving him time to get his coat. The defendant became angry and obstreperous when the officers refused to let him go back into the house to retrieve his coat. The officers left him handcuffed outside in the street, waiting for a special squad car to arrive. The arrest warrant was later vacated.

Can the defendant properly be convicted of violating the statute?

一名被告根据一项法规被指控犯罪，该法规规定如下：“任何人在醉酒状态下，出现在任何公共场所，并通过吵闹或不雅行为表现出醉酒状态的，构成轻罪。”

在审判中，证据显示，当警察根据有效逮捕令冲入其住宅并逮捕他时，被告处于醉酒状态。那是一个寒冷的夜晚，警察催促被告离开他的住宅，没有给他时间去拿外套。当警察拒绝让他返回住宅取外套时，被告变得愤怒和吵闹。警察将他铐在街上，等待特勤警车前来。该逮捕令后来被撤销。

被告是否可以因违反该法规而被恰当定罪？
options:
A. No, because the defendant's claim of mistreatment is valid.
不可以，因为被告关于不当对待的主张是成立的。

B. No, because the statute requires proof of a voluntary appearance in a public place.
不可以，因为该法规要求证明被告是自愿出现在公共场所。

C. Yes, because the defendant voluntarily became intoxicated.
可以，因为被告是自愿进入醉酒状态的。

D. Yes, because the defendant voluntarily behaved in an obstreperous manner.
可以，因为被告自愿地以吵闹的方式行事。
data.explanation:
Every crime requires proof that the defendant voluntarily committed the actus reus by
  • consciously performing a bodily movement or
  • failing to act when he/she had a legal duty and the ability to do so.
Therefore, no criminal liability can be imposed when an act does not result from the defendant's free will.

Here, the defendant was charged with appearing in a public place and manifesting a drunken condition by obstreperous (ie, disorderly) or indecent conduct while intoxicated. The defendant voluntarily became intoxicated and voluntarily behaved obstreperously outside his home (Choices C & D). But he appeared in this public place against his will because police hustled him out of his home and kept him from reentering. And since this crime (like all others) requires that the actus reus be voluntary, the defendant cannot be convicted.

(Choice A) The defendant may have a valid mistreatment claim since the police wrongfully deprived him of his coat. But this will not prevent the defendant's conviction since mistreatment would not negate an element of the charged crime.

Educational objective: A criminal conviction requires proof that the defendant voluntarily committed the criminal act or omission. Therefore, an act that is not a product of the defendant's free will cannot be used to impose criminal liability.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 81%（正确选项），C选项 2%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

每项犯罪都要求证明被告自愿实施了犯罪行为 (actus reus)，其方式为
  • 有意识地做出身体动作，或
  • 在有法律义务和能力作为时未作为。
因此，当一个行为并非出于被告的自由意志时，不能被追究刑事责任。

在本案中，被告被指控在醉酒状态下出现在公共场所，并通过吵闹（即妨害秩序）或不雅行为表现出醉酒状态。被告自愿进入醉酒状态，并在其住宅外自愿地表现出吵闹行为（选项C和D）。但他出现在这个公共场所是违背其意愿的，因为警察将他从家中催赶出来，并阻止他再次进入。而且，由于这项犯罪（和所有其他犯罪一样）要求犯罪行为 (actus reus) 必须是自愿的，因此被告不能被定罪。

（选项A）被告可能会有一个成立的关于不当对待的主张，因为警察不当剥夺了他的外套。但这并不能阻止被告被定罪，因为不当对待并不能否定被指控犯罪的任何一个要素。

教学目的：刑事定罪要求证明被告自愿实施了犯罪行为或不作为。因此，一个并非出于被告自由意志的行为，不能被用来追究刑事责任。

MBE 刑法考点解析

Actus Reus & Voluntariness
正确答案：选项 B

本题考察的是刑法中最基础但也最核心的概念之一：犯罪行为的自愿性 (Voluntariness of the Actus Reus)。

核心法律原则

规则： 所有的犯罪（Strict Liability 犯罪除外，但即使是严格责任犯罪也需要自愿行为）都要求被告实施了自愿的 (Voluntary) 身体动作。

如果被告的行为是被迫的、反射性的、或是在无意识状态下进行的，则不构成刑法意义上的 Actus Reus（犯罪行为）。

Martin v. State (1944)
这是一个美国法学院必读的经典判例。被告在家中醉酒，警察强行将其带到高速公路上，然后指控他在公共场所醉酒。法院裁定：由于被告出现在公共场所是被迫的（involuntary），因此不能定罪。
本题深度解析

让我们拆解本案中的法规要素：

  • 要素 1： 处于醉酒状态 (While intoxicated)
  • 要素 2： 出现在公共场所 (Appears in any public place) ← 关键点
  • 要素 3： 表现出吵闹或不雅行为 (Manifests... by obstreperous conduct)

逻辑推演：

虽然被告满足了要素1（他在家喝醉了）和要素3（他在街上大喊大叫），但他未能满足要素2的自愿性要求。

被告是被警察“催促离开住宅”并“铐在街上”的。他出现在公共场所（街道）这一事实，完全是警察行为的结果，而非被告的自由意志 (Free Will)。因此，犯罪行为的必要组成部分缺失，不能定罪。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (Mistreatment)：
虽然警察不让他拿外套可能构成民事侵权或违反程序，但这并不是刑法上的抗辩理由 (Defense)。它不能否定犯罪构成的要素。
选项 C (Voluntary Intoxication)：
被告确实是自愿喝醉的，但这只满足了要素1。法规惩罚的不是“在家喝醉”，而是“在公共场所喝醉”。自愿喝醉不能弥补“被迫进入公共场所”这一要素的缺失。
选项 D (Voluntary Conduct)：
虽然他在街上吵闹是自愿的，但前提是他必须是自愿出现在那里的。如果一个人被绑架并扔到银行里，即使他在银行里大喊大叫，也不能指控他“非法闯入银行”。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
看到“Public Intoxication”（公共场所醉酒）的题目，一定要检查被告是如何到达公共场所的。如果是被警察搬运、拖拽或强迫带出的，通常都因缺乏 Voluntary Act 而无罪。

questions.question:
A woman experiencing homelessness broke into the basement of a hotel and fell asleep. She was awakened by a security guard, who demanded that she leave. As the woman was leaving, she cursed the security guard. Angered, the guard began to beat the woman on her head with his flashlight. After the second blow, the woman grabbed a fire extinguisher and sprayed the guard in his face, causing him to lose his sight in one eye.
The jurisdiction defines aggravated assault as assault with intent to cause serious bodily injury.
The crimes below are listed in descending order of seriousness. What is the most serious crime of which the woman could be properly convicted?

choices.a: Aggravated assault.
choices.b: Burglary.
choices.c: Assault.
choices.d: Trespass.

questions.question:
Throughout her life, the defendant had visions of an unknown woman who told her to commit inappropriate, and sometimes violent, acts. The defendant truly believed that the unknown woman had her best interests at heart and that, therefore, whatever the woman said to do was right. The defendant had a history of self-medicating with drugs and alcohol, which helped her ignore the visions. One month, the defendant was so consistently intoxicated that she inadvertently forgot to pay her rent. When the defendant's landlord came to the door to remind her to pay, the defendant began to have visions of the unknown woman telling her to kill her landlord. The defendant grabbed a letter opener that happened to be by the front door and stabbed her landlord with it.
The defendant has been charged with second-degree murder in a jurisdiction that uses the M'Naghten test. A state statute defines second-degree murder as common-law murder.
What is the defendant's best defense against this charge?

choices.a: Involuntary intoxication.
choices.b: Insanity.
choices.c: No malice aforethought.
choices.d: No premeditation.

questions.question:
One evening, a man had several drinks and then started to drive home. As he was proceeding down Main Boulevard, an automobile pulled out of a side street to his right. The man's car struck this automobile broadside. The driver of the other car was killed as a result of the collision. A breath-analysis test administered after the accident showed that the man satisfied the legal definition of intoxication.
If the man is prosecuted for manslaughter, which of the following arguments would give him the best chance for acquittal?

choices.a: Because of his intoxication, the man lacked the mens rea needed for manslaughter.
choices.b: Driving while intoxicated requires no mens rea and therefore cannot be the basis for misdemeanor manslaughter.
choices.c: The collision would have occurred even if the man had not been intoxicated.
choices.d: The other driver was contributorily negligent.

data.questionStem:
Q85091

One evening, a man had several drinks and then started to drive home. As he was proceeding down Main Boulevard, an automobile pulled out of a side street to his right. The man's car struck this automobile broadside. The driver of the other car was killed as a result of the collision. A breath-analysis test administered after the accident showed that the man satisfied the legal definition of intoxication.

If the man is prosecuted for manslaughter, which of the following arguments would give him the best chance for acquittal?

一天晚上，一名男子喝了几杯酒后开始开车回家。当他沿着 Main Boulevard 行驶时，一辆汽车从他右边的辅路驶出。该男子的车撞上了这辆车的侧面。另一辆车的司机因这次碰撞而死亡。事故后进行的呼吸分析测试显示，该男子符合醉酒的法律定义。

如果该男子被以过失杀人罪（manslaughter）起诉，以下哪项论点能让他有最大的机会被判无罪？
options:
A. Because of his intoxication, the man lacked the mens rea needed for manslaughter.
由于醉酒，该男子缺乏构成过失杀人罪（manslaughter）所需的犯罪意图（mens rea）。

B. Driving while intoxicated requires no mens rea and therefore cannot be the basis for misdemeanor manslaughter.
醉酒驾驶不需要犯罪意图（mens rea），因此不能作为轻罪过失杀人罪（misdemeanor manslaughter）的基础。

C. The collision would have occurred even if the man had not been intoxicated.
即使该男子没有醉酒，碰撞也同样会发生。

D. The other driver was contributorily negligent.
另一名司机存在与有过失。
data.explanation:
Criminal causation


Actual (factual) causeSingle cause - but for defendant's conduct, crime would not have occurred
Multiple causes - defendant's conduct was substantial factor causing crime
Proximate (legal) causeCrime was natural, probable & foreseeable consequence of defendant's conduct
There are two types of manslaughter :

  • Voluntary - an intentional killing mitigated by adequate provocation (ie, heat of passion) or, in some jurisdictions, other mitigating factors (eg, imperfect self-defense)
  • Involuntary - an unintentional killing that is caused by criminal negligence or occurs during the commission of an unlawful act (eg, misdemeanor manslaughter)


But to be convicted of manslaughter, the defendant's conduct must be the actual (ie, but for) cause and proximate (ie, foreseeable) cause of the specified result - the victim's death.

Here, the man's car struck a driver's vehicle, and the driver died as a result of the collision. The man would likely be charged with involuntary manslaughter since the collision occurred when he was driving under the influence of alcohol. But his unlawful act would not be the actual cause of the driver's death if the collision would have occurred even if the man had not been intoxicated. And since actual causation is required for a manslaughter conviction, this is the man's strong argument for acquittal.

(Choice A) Voluntary intoxication is a defense to a specific intent crime if the intoxication negated the requisite mens rea. But it is no defense to lesser intent crimes - eg, involuntary manslaughter stemming from criminal negligence (as seen here).

(Choice B) Any criminal act that is malum in se (ie, inherently wrong) - including driving while intoxicated - can serve as a basis for misdemeanor manslaughter, even if the criminal act requires no mens rea.

(Choice D) Even if the driver's negligence contributed to his death, the man could still be convicted of manslaughter if his drunk driving was a substantial factor in causing that death.

Educational objective: Crimes that require a specific result (eg, homicide) require proof that the defendant's conduct was both the actual (ie, but for) and proximate (ie, foreseeable) cause of that result.

选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 3%，C选项 60%（正确选项），D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

刑事因果关系


事实上的原因（实际原因）单一原因 - 若无被告的行为，犯罪便不会发生
多重原因 - 被告的行为是导致犯罪发生的重要因素
法律上的原因（近因）犯罪是被告行为的自然的、可能的且可预见的结果
过失杀人罪（manslaughter）有两种类型：

  • 自愿过失杀人 - 指因受到充分挑衅（即一时激愤）或在某些司法管辖区中，因其他减轻处罚情节（例如，不完美的自卫）而减轻处罚的故意杀人行为
  • 非自愿过失杀人 - 指由刑事过失导致的非故意杀人，或在实施非法行为（例如，轻罪过失杀人）过程中发生的杀人行为


但要被判犯有过失杀人罪，被告的行为必须是受害者死亡这一特定结果的事实原因（即“若无”原因）和法律原因（即“可预见的”原因）。

在本案中，该男子的车撞上了一名司机的车辆，该司机因碰撞而死亡。由于碰撞发生在该男子受酒精影响下驾驶时，他很可能被控非自愿过失杀人罪。但如果即使该男子没有醉酒，碰撞也同样会发生，那么他的非法行为就不是该司机死亡的事实原因。由于事实上的因果关系是过失杀人罪定罪的必要条件，这是该男子争取无罪判决的有力论点。

(选项 A) 如果醉酒状态排除了必要的犯罪意图（mens rea），那么自愿醉酒可以作为特定意图犯罪的辩护理由。但对于意图程度较低的犯罪——例如，本案中由刑事过失引起的非自愿过失杀人罪——它不能作为辩护理由。

(选项 B) 任何本身即为不法（malum in se）的犯罪行为（即，本质上是错误的）——包括醉酒驾驶——都可以作为轻罪过失杀人罪的基础，即使该犯罪行为不需要犯罪意图（mens rea）。

(选项 D) 即使司机的过失促成了其自身的死亡，但如果该男子的醉酒驾驶是导致该死亡的一个重要因素，他仍可能被判犯有过失杀人罪。

教学目的：要求特定结果的犯罪（例如，杀人罪）需要证明被告的行为是该结果的事实原因（即“若无”原因）和法律原因（即“可预见的”原因）。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：刑事因果关系

✅ 正确答案：C

本题的核心考点在于刑法中的因果关系 (Causation)。对于任何要求特定结果的犯罪（Result Crimes，如杀人罪），检方必须证明被告的行为是导致结果发生的事实原因和法律原因。

1. 核心解析：事实原因 (Actual Cause)

“若无”规则 (But-For Test)
这是判断事实原因最常用的标准：若无被告的行为，危害结果是否还会发生？
But for the defendant's conduct, would the result have occurred?

在本案中，被告被控过失杀人（Manslaughter），通常是基于其“醉酒驾驶”这一非法行为或刑事过失。

然而，要定罪，必须证明是“醉酒驾驶”导致了死亡。

  • 选项 C 的逻辑：如果即使被告没有醉酒（即他是清醒的），碰撞也同样会发生（例如因为受害者突然冲出，任何反应敏捷的司机都无法避免），那么被告的醉酒行为就不是导致死亡的事实原因。
  • 结论：如果切断了行为与结果之间的因果链条，犯罪构成的客观要件就不完整，被告必须被判无罪。这是最彻底的辩护理由。

2. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

  • 选项 A (Mens Rea/犯罪意图)：错误。
    自愿醉酒（Voluntary Intoxication）通常只能作为“特定意图犯罪”（Specific Intent Crimes）的辩护。过失杀人（Manslaughter）通常属于一般意图或基于过失的犯罪，醉酒不能用来否定其犯罪意图。
  • 选项 B (Misdemeanor Manslaughter)：错误。
    醉酒驾驶本身是违法的（Malum in se 或 Malum prohibitum），可以作为“轻罪过失杀人”的基础。不需要证明被告有杀人的意图，只要证明他在实施非法行为导致了死亡即可。
  • 选项 D (Contributory Negligence/与有过失)：错误。
    这是一个常见的陷阱。在侵权法 (Torts) 中，受害者的过失可能减轻或免除被告责任；但在刑法 (Criminal Law) 中，受害者的疏忽通常不是被告的辩护理由，除非受害者的行为极其离谱，构成了“介入原因”（Superseding Cause），完全切断了被告行为的因果关系。仅仅是“与有过失”不足以让被告脱罪。
💡MBE 考试技巧：
当题目涉及“杀人罪”或“过失犯罪”时，务必检查因果关系。如果题目暗示“无论被告怎么做，结果都会发生”，那么这就是在测试事实因果关系（Actual Cause）的缺失。这是比意图（Mens Rea）或受害者过失更基础、更强有力的无罪理由。

questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with battery for breaking a man's nose in a bar fight. At trial, the evidence established the following: The defendant was watching a contentious football game with the man when the defendant yelled obscenities about the man's favorite football team. In response to the defendant's remarks, the man yelled obscenities about the defendant. The defendant stood up from his chair, walked over to where the man was sitting, raised his fist and said, "One more word and I'll shut your mouth for you." The man then grabbed the defendant by the shirt and started waving a knife at the defendant in an effort to stab him. The defendant proceeded to punch the man several times until the man released the defendant's shirt.
Should the defendant be convicted of battery?

choices.a: No, because a person may use any amount of force to repel an attack.
choices.b: No, because the man attempted to use deadly force against him.
choices.c: Yes, because the defendant failed to retreat.
choices.d: Yes, because the defendant was the initial aggressor.

Should the defendant be convicted of battery?

一名被告因在酒吧斗殴中打断一名男子的鼻子而被指控犯有伤害罪(battery)。在庭审中，证据证实了以下事实：被告与该男子一同观看一场充满争议的橄榄球比赛时，被告对该男子最喜欢的球队大声辱骂。作为对被告言论的回应，该男子也对被告大声辱骂。被告从椅子上站起来，走到该男子坐的地方，举起拳头说：“你再说一个字，我就让你闭嘴。”该男子随后抓住被告的衬衫，并开始向被告挥舞刀具，试图刺伤他。被告于是连续击打该男子数拳，直到该男子松开被告的衬衫。

被告是否应被判犯有伤害罪(battery)？
options:
A. No, because a person may use any amount of force to repel an attack.
不应定罪，因为一个人可以使用任何程度的武力来抵御攻击。

B. No, because the man attempted to use deadly force against him.
不应定罪，因为该男子试图对他使用致命武力。

C. Yes, because the defendant failed to retreat.
应该定罪，因为被告未能退让。

D. Yes, because the defendant was the initial aggressor.
应该定罪，因为被告是最初的攻击者。
data.explanation:
Battery is the unlawful application of force (eg, a punch) to another person that causes offensive contact or bodily harm (eg, a black eye). Therefore, the defendant committed battery. However, an otherwise unlawful use of force may be justified if it was done in self-defense. This justification generally does not extend to an initial aggressor - ie, the person who first uses or threatens physical force. However, an initial aggressor may gain the right to act in self-defense in two circumstances :
  • When the initial aggressor's use of nondeadly force is met with deadly force †
  • When the initial aggressor, in good faith, completely withdraws from the altercation and communicates that fact to the victim
Although merely using obscenities does not alone make a person an initial aggressor, the defendant assumed this role when he walked over to the man and threatened to strike him. The defendant's nondeadly threat was then met with deadly force when the man grabbed and waved a knife at the defendant in an attempt to stab him. This gave the defendant the right to act in self-defense by using reasonable force to prevent imminent unlawful harm to himself (Choice A).

Reasonable force means that a person may only use as much force as is required to repel the attack. Here, the defendant used reasonable force since he punched the man only until the man released the defendant's shirt. As a result, the battery against the man was justified and the defendant should not be convicted of this crime (Choice D).

†The initial aggressor may not claim self-defense when he/she initially used deadly force against the victim.

(Choice C) There is no duty to retreat before using nondeadly force in self-defense (as seen here), even if there is an opportunity to do so safely.

Educational objective: An initial aggressor can only claim self-defense if (1) the aggressor's use of nondeadly force was met with deadly force or (2) the aggressor, in good faith, completely withdrew from the altercation and communicated that fact to the victim.



选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 81%（正确选项），C选项 0%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

伤害罪(Battery)是指对他人非法使用武力（例如，拳击），导致冒犯性接触或身体伤害（例如，黑眼圈）。因此，被告实施了伤害罪。然而，如果是在自卫情况下，本属非法的武力使用可能是正当的。这种正当理由通常不适用于最初的攻击者——即首先使用或威胁使用身体暴力的人。但是，最初的攻击者在两种情况下可以获得自卫的权利：
  • 当最初攻击者使用的非致命武力遭遇了致命武力†时
  • 当最初攻击者善意地完全退出争执，并将此意图传达给受害人时
尽管仅仅使用侮辱性言语本身并不会使人成为最初的攻击者，但当被告走向该男子并威胁要打他时，被告就扮演了这一角色。当该男子抓住被告并向其挥舞刀具试图刺伤他时，被告的非致命威胁遭遇了致命武力。这赋予了被告以自卫的权利，通过使用合理的武力来防止对自己即将发生的不法伤害（选项 A）。

合理的武力意味着一个人只能使用抵御攻击所必需的武力。在此案中，被告使用了合理的武力，因为他只是一直击打该男子，直到该男子松开被告的衬衫为止。因此，对该男子的伤害行为是正当的，被告不应被判犯有此罪（选项 D）。

†当最初攻击者首先对受害人使用致命武力时，其不得主张自卫。

（选项 C）在使用非致命武力进行自卫时（如本案所示），没有退让的义务，即使有机会安全退让。

教学目标：最初的攻击者只有在以下情况下才能主张自卫：（1）攻击者使用的非致命武力遭遇了致命武力；或（2）攻击者善意地完全退出了争执，并将此意图传达给了受害人。

References

6 Am. Jur. 2d Assault and Battery § 53 (2020) (explaining when an initial aggressor gains the right to act in self-defense).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

刑法：自卫与最初攻击者
核心规则：最初攻击者规则 (Initial Aggressor Rule)

通常情况下，最初攻击者（即首先挑起肢体冲突的人）没有自卫权。

但在以下两种例外情况下，最初攻击者可以恢复 (Regain) 自卫权：

  • 善意退出 (Withdrawal)： 攻击者明确表示停止战斗并试图离开。
  • 局势升级 (Escalation)： 攻击者使用非致命武力，但受害者反击时使用了致命武力。
第一阶段：冲突开始

被告走向受害人，举起拳头威胁。被告构成了袭击 (Assault)，并成为最初攻击者 (Initial Aggressor)。

⚠️ 关键点： 此时被告使用的是非致命武力 (Non-deadly force)。

↓
第二阶段：局势升级

受害人掏出刀并挥舞。受害人使用了致命武力 (Deadly force)。

⚖️ 法律后果： 由于受害人将冲突从“非致命”升级为“致命”，被告作为最初攻击者，此时恢复了自卫权。

↓
第三阶段：自卫行为

被告用拳头击打受害人直到对方松手。这是为了保护自己免受刺伤而使用的合理武力 (Reasonable force)。

选项深度解析

选项 B (正确)

“不应定罪，因为该男子试图对他使用致命武力。”

这是本题的题眼。虽然被告先动手（挑衅/举拳），但他只使用了非致命武力。当受害人拿出刀（致命武力）时，被告面临死亡或重伤的紧迫威胁，因此有权使用武力进行自卫。被告的行为符合“局势升级”例外 (Escalation Exception)。

选项 D (错误)

“应该定罪，因为被告是最初的攻击者。”

这个选项只说对了一半。被告确实是最初攻击者，但它忽略了例外情况。MBE 经常考察规则的例外。当受害人反应过度（用刀回应拳头）时，最初攻击者的身份不再阻碍其行使自卫权。

选项 A (错误)

“...可以使用任何程度的武力...”

法律中的关键词是“合理 (Reasonable)”。自卫所使用的武力必须与威胁成比例。虽然本案中被告无罪，但理由不是因为他可以用“任何”武力，而是因为他用了“合理”的武力。

选项 C (错误)

“...因为被告未能退让。”

首先，在使用非致命武力进行自卫时，绝大多数司法管辖区都没有退让义务 (Duty to Retreat)。其次，即使有退让义务，当面对紧迫的致命威胁（刀）时，被告通过反击来解除武装通常被视为合理的。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧 在刑法题目中，如果看到两人互殴：
  1. 先判断谁先动手（谁是 Initial Aggressor）。
  2. 紧接着看武力等级是否发生了变化（例如：拳头 vs 刀/枪）。
  3. 如果受害人突然将武力升级为致命武力，最初的挑衅者通常会获得自卫权（洗白）。

A high school student's teacher told the student that she was going to receive a failing grade in history, which would prevent her from graduating. Furious, she reported to the principal that the teacher had fondled her, and he was fired. A year later, still unable to get work because of the scandal, the teacher committed suicide. The student, remorseful, confessed that her accusation had been false.
If the student is charged with manslaughter, what is her best defense?

choices.a: She acted under extreme emotional distress.
choices.b: She committed no act that proximately caused the teacher's death.
choices.c: She did not act with malice.
choices.d: She did not intend to cause the teacher's death.

If the student is charged with manslaughter, what is her best defense?

一名高中生的历史老师告诉该学生，她的历史课成绩将不及格，这将导致她无法毕业。学生一怒之下向校长举报说老师抚摸了她，老师因此被解雇。一年后，这位老师因为这桩丑闻仍然找不到工作，于是自杀身亡。学生心生悔意，承认她的指控是虚假的。

如果该学生被控过失杀人罪 (manslaughter)，她最好的辩护理由是什么？
options:
A. She acted under extreme emotional distress.
她的行为是在极端情绪困扰下作出的。

B. She committed no act that proximately caused the teacher's death.
她的行为并未近因导致老师的死亡。

C. She did not act with malice.
她的行为不带恶意 (malice)。

D. She did not intend to cause the teacher's death.
她无意导致老师的死亡。
data.explanation:
Criminal causation


Actual (factual) causeSingle cause - but for defendant's conduct, crime would not have occurred Multiple causes - defendant's conduct was substantial factor causing crime
Proximate (legal) causeCrime was natural, probable & foreseeable consequence of defendant's conduct
There are two types of manslaughter :
  • Voluntary - an intentional killing mitigated by adequate provocation (ie, heat-of-passion killing) or, in some jurisdictions, other mitigating factors (eg, imperfect self-defense)
  • Involuntary - an unintentional killing committed with criminal negligence or during an unlawful act (eg, misdemeanor manslaughter)


A conviction of either crime requires proof that the defendant's conduct was both the actual ("but for") cause and proximate (foreseeable) cause of the victim's death. Here, the teacher committed suicide after the student falsely accused him of fondling her. The student would likely be charged with involuntary manslaughter since there is no evidence that she intended to cause the teacher's death (Choice D). And though the teacher would not have died but for the student's accusation (actual causation), the student is not guilty of manslaughter if she committed no act that proximately caused that death - ie, if the suicide was unforeseeable. Therefore, that is the student's best defense.

(Choice A) Extreme emotional distress is not a defense to a crime - but it can be a mitigating factor at sentencing. Here, however, the student's distress at her failing grade would hardly mitigate a false sexual-misconduct report.

(Choice C) Malice aforethought is a requirement for murder - not manslaughter.

Educational objective: A manslaughter conviction requires proof that the defendant's conduct was both the actual ("but for") and proximate (foreseeable) cause of the victim's death.

选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 75%（正确选项），C选项 5%，D选项 15%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

刑事因果关系


事实上的因果关系 (Actual/factual cause)单一原因 - 若无被告的行为，犯罪便不会发生
多重原因 - 被告的行为是导致犯罪的实质性因素
法律上的近因 (Proximate/legal cause)犯罪是被告行为的自然的、可能的及可预见的后果
过失杀人罪 (manslaughter) 有两种类型：
  • 自愿过失杀人 (Voluntary manslaughter) - 因受到充分挑衅（即激情杀人）或在某些司法管辖区内，因其他减罪情节（如不完善的自卫 imperfect self-defense）而减轻处罚的故意杀人
  • 非自愿过失杀人 (Involuntary manslaughter) - 因刑事过失或在从事非法行为（如轻罪过失杀人 misdemeanor manslaughter）过程中犯下的非故意杀人


任何一种罪名的定罪都要求证明被告的行为既是受害者死亡的事实原因（“若无”原因），也是近因（可预见的）原因。在本案中，老师在学生诬告他抚摸自己后自杀。该学生很可能被控非自愿过失杀人罪 (involuntary manslaughter)，因为没有证据表明她意图导致老师的死亡（选项D）。尽管若无学生的指控（事实上的因果关系），老师便不会死亡，但如果学生的行为并未近因导致该死亡——即如果自杀是不可预见的——那么该学生就不构成过失杀人罪。因此，这是学生最好的辩护理由。

（选项A）极端情绪困扰不是一项罪行的辩护理由——但它在量刑时可以作为一个减罪因素。然而，在本案中，学生因成绩不及格而感到的困扰，几乎不足以减轻其虚假性行为不端报告的严重性。

（选项C）预谋恶意 (Malice aforethought) 是谋杀罪 (murder) 的一个要件——而非过失杀人罪 (manslaughter) 的要件。

教学目标：过失杀人罪 (manslaughter) 的定罪要求证明，被告的行为既是受害者死亡的事实原因（“若无”原因），也是其近因（可预见的）原因。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Causation
核心考点：刑事因果关系 (Causation)

在刑法中，要证明被告对结果（如死亡）负责，必须同时证明两层因果关系：

  • 事实原因 (Actual Cause / Cause-in-Fact)： 即 "But-for" test。若无被告行为，结果是否会发生？
  • 法律近因 (Proximate Cause / Legal Cause)： 结果是否是被告行为的可预见 (Foreseeable) 后果？
本案深度解析

本题的核心在于法律近因 (Proximate Cause) 的中断。

虽然学生的谎言是老师死亡的“事实原因”（没有谎言，老师不会失业，可能不会自杀），但法律上需要判断这种死亡是否是谎言的“自然且可预见”的后果。

关键规则： 在普通法中，受害人自愿的自杀 (Suicide) 通常被视为一个独立的介入行为 Superseding Intervening Act，它会切断被告行为与死亡结果之间的因果链条。

除非被告的行为导致受害人精神失常无法控制自己，或者被告实施了极度残忍的行为导致受害人为了逃避痛苦而立即自杀，否则一年后的自杀在法律上被认为是不可预见的 (Unforeseeable)。

选项分析
选项 B (正确答案)

"She committed no act that proximately caused the teacher's death."

这是最佳辩护。因为老师的自杀打破了因果链条。如果缺乏法律近因 (Proximate Cause)，过失杀人罪 (Manslaughter) 的客观要件就不成立，无论被告是否有过错。

选项 D (常见干扰项)

"She did not intend to cause the teacher's death."

错误原因： 题目指控的是 Manslaughter（过失杀人）。

过失杀人（特别是 Involuntary Manslaughter）不需要杀人意图 (Intent to kill)。它通常基于刑事过失 (Criminal Negligence) 或鲁莽 (Recklessness)。因此，“没有意图”并不是针对过失杀人罪的完整辩护。

选项 C

"She did not act with malice."

错误原因： Malice (恶意/预谋) 是谋杀罪 (Murder) 的要素，而不是过失杀人罪的要素。证明没有 Malice 只能避免被判 Murder，但不能通过此点来辩护 Manslaughter。

选项 A

"She acted under extreme emotional distress."

错误原因： 情绪困扰通常只影响量刑，或者在特定情况下将 Murder 降格为 Voluntary Manslaughter（激情杀人）。但在本案中，因成绩不及格而诬告老师，法律上不认可其为合理的“激愤”理由，且这不能否定犯罪的基本构成要件。

🎓 MBE 答题技巧 当题目涉及受害人自身的行为（如拒绝治疗、自杀、冒险行为）发生在被告行为之后时，请立即思考“介入原因” (Intervening Acts)。

如果该介入行为是不可预见的 (Unforeseeable)，它就是阻断原因 (Superseding Cause)，被告将对最终结果不承担刑事责任。

questions.question: In which of the following situations would a court applying common law doctrine be most likely to convict a defendant of the crime charged, despite the defendant's mistake?

choices.a: The defendant was charged with assault with intent to rape a woman who he mistakenly believed had agreed to have sexual intercourse with him.
choices.b: The defendant was charged with bigamy. He married his neighbor four years after her husband was reported missing at sea. The rescued husband returns alive. A state statute provides that a person is presumed dead after five years of unexplained absence. The defendant believed the statutory period was three years.
choices.c: The defendant was charged with burglary. He had broken into an office where he once worked and had taken a typewriter that he erroneously believed had been given to him before he was fired.
choices.d: The defendant was charged with murder after he shot and killed a man who had extorted money from him. The defendant mistakenly thought the victim had raised his hand to shoot when, in fact, the victim was shaking his fist at the defendant to frighten him.

data.questionStem:
Q85127

In which of the following situations would a court applying common law doctrine be most likely to convict a defendant of the crime charged, despite the defendant's mistake?

在下列哪种情况下，适用普通法原则的法院最有可能在被告人存在认识错误的情况下，仍判定其所控罪名成立？
options:
A. The defendant was charged with assault with intent to rape a woman who he mistakenly believed had agreed to have sexual intercourse with him.
被告人被控意图强奸的攻击罪，他错误地认为该女性已同意与他发生性关系。

B. The defendant was charged with bigamy. He married his neighbor four years after her husband was reported missing at sea. The rescued husband returns alive. A state statute provides that a person is presumed dead after five years of unexplained absence. The defendant believed the statutory period was three years.
被告人被控重婚罪。他在其邻居的丈夫据报在海上失踪四年后与她结婚。之后，被救回的丈夫活着回来了。一项州法律规定，无故失踪五年后，该人即被推定死亡。被告人认为该法定期限是三年。

C. The defendant was charged with burglary. He had broken into an office where he once worked and had taken a typewriter that he erroneously believed had been given to him before he was fired.
被告人被控入室犯法罪。他闯入了他曾经工作过的一间办公室，并拿走了一台他错误地认为在被解雇前已赠予他的打字机。

D. The defendant was charged with murder after he shot and killed a man who had extorted money from him. The defendant mistakenly thought the victim had raised his hand to shoot when, in fact, the victim was shaking his fist at the defendant to frighten him.
被告人因开枪打死一名曾向他勒索金钱的男子而被控谋杀罪。被告人错误地认为受害人举手准备开枪，而事实上，受害人只是在向被告人挥舞拳头以吓唬他。
data.explanation:
Mistake of law v. Mistake of fact


DefinitionApplicability
Mistake of lawDefendant mistakenly believes conduct not prohibited by lawNo defense unless:
  • Law prohibiting conduct was unavailable
  • Defendant reasonably relied on invalid law
  • Mistake negates mens rea
Mistake of factDefendant is mistaken as to a matter of factWhen mistake negates mens rea:
  • Specific intent - defense if honest mistake
  • General intent & malice - defense if honest & reasonable mistake
  • Strict liability - no defense
Mens rea - state of mind necessary to be guilty of criminal offense

Mistake of fact is a defense to criminal liability for:
  • specific intent crimes - when the defendant's honest mistake, even if unreasonable, negates the requisite mens rea and
  • general intent crimes - when the defendant's honest and reasonable mistake negates the requisite mens rea.
But mistake of law is almost never a defense to criminal liability. As a result, the court would likely convict the defendant of bigamy - ie, marrying someone who already has a living spouse - despite his mistaken belief that the neighbor's husband was presumed by law to be dead.

(Choice A) Assault with intent to rape requires proof that the defendant specifically intended to commit rape - at common law, sexual intercourse with a woman (other than the defendant's wife) against her will by force or threat of force. Since the defendant's mistaken belief that the woman had agreed to sexual intercourse shows that he did not intend to rape her, he would not be convicted of assault with intent to rape.

(Choice C) Common law burglary is the breaking and entering of another's dwelling at night with the specific intent to commit a felony therein. Here, the defendant's mistaken belief that the typewriter was his negates the necessary intent to commit a felony (no intent to steal). Therefore, he would not be convicted of burglary.

(Choice D) Common law murder is an unlawful killing committed with malice aforethought. But murder may be reduced to voluntary manslaughter when, as here, the defendant mistakenly believed that deadly force was necessary for self-defense. So the defendant would likely be convicted of voluntary manslaughter - not murder.

Educational objective: An honest mistake of fact is a defense to specific intent crimes (even if unreasonable) and general intent crimes (if reasonable) when it negates the requisite mens rea. But mistake of law is almost never a defense.

选项正确率统计：A选项 14%，B选项 65%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

法律认识错误 vs. 事实认识错误


定义适用性
法律认识错误被告人错误地认为其行为未被法律禁止不构成抗辩理由，除非：
  • 禁止该行为的法律无法获取
  • 被告人合理信赖了无效的法律
  • 认识错误排除了犯罪意图
事实认识错误被告人对某一事实存在认识错误当认识错误排除犯罪意图时：
  • 特定意图 - 如果是善意的认识错误，则构成抗辩
  • 一般意图与恶意 - 如果是善意且合理的认识错误，则构成抗辩
  • 严格责任 - 不构成抗辩
Mens rea - 判定刑事犯罪成立所必需的心理状态

事实认识错误是以下情况下的刑事责任抗辩理由：
  • 特定意图犯罪——当被告人善意的认识错误（即使不合理）排除了必要的犯罪意图（mens rea），以及
  • 一般意图犯罪——当被告人善意且合理的认识错误排除了必要的犯罪意图时。
但法律认识错误几乎从不构成刑事责任的抗辩理由。因此，法院很可能判定被告人犯有重婚罪——即与一个尚有在世配偶的人结婚——尽管他错误地认为其邻居的丈夫在法律上已被推定死亡。

(选项A) 意图强奸的攻击罪要求证明被告人有强奸的特定意图——在普通法中，强奸指通过暴力或暴力威胁，违背妇女（非被告人妻子）意愿与其发生性关系。由于被告人错误地认为该女性已同意发生性关系，这表明他没有强奸的意图，因此他不会被判意图强奸的攻击罪。

(选项C) 普通法上的入室犯法罪（burglary）是指在夜间侵入他人住所，并意图在内实施重罪的特定意图犯罪。在此案中，被告人错误地认为打字机是自己的，这一认识错误排除了实施重罪的必要意图（没有盗窃的意图）。因此，他不会被判入室犯法罪。

(选项D) 普通法上的谋杀罪是指怀有预谋恶意（malice aforethought）实施的非法杀人行为。但是，当被告人错误地认为为自卫必须使用致命武力时（如本案所示），谋杀罪可降为任意过失杀人罪（voluntary manslaughter）。因此，被告人很可能被判任意过失杀人罪，而非谋杀罪。

教学目的：当善意的事实认识错误排除了必要的犯罪意图（mens rea）时，它构成对特定意图犯罪（即使该认识错误不合理）和一般意图犯罪（如果该认识错误合理）的抗辩理由。但法律认识错误几乎从不构成抗辩理由。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：认识错误

本题考察的是刑法中“事实认识错误” (Mistake of Fact) 与 “法律认识错误” (Mistake of Law) 的关键区别。

核心原则：

在普通法 (Common Law) 下，法律认识错误通常不能作为抗辩理由，而事实认识错误在特定条件下可以作为抗辩。

"Ignorantia juris non excusat" (不知法不免责)

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 B)

法律认识错误

案情：被告人被控重婚罪 (Bigamy)。他知道妻子失踪了4年，但他错误地认为法律规定的推定死亡时间是3年（实际上是5年）。

解析：

  • 被告人对事实（失踪4年）很清楚，他的错误在于对法律条文（Statute）的理解。
  • 这就是典型的法律认识错误 (Mistake of Law)。
  • 即使被告人的信念是真诚的，法律认识错误也不能作为重婚罪的抗辩理由。因此，法院最有可能判定其罪名成立。

❌ 其他选项为何不成立？

其他选项均属于事实认识错误 (Mistake of Fact)，且该错误否定了犯罪意图 (Mens Rea)，因此被告人通常会被判无罪或罪名减轻。

特定意图犯罪

选项 A (意图强奸)：
这是特定意图犯罪 (Specific Intent Crime)。被告人错误地认为受害人同意（事实错误）。这一错误直接否定了“意图强奸”所需的心理状态。只要错误是真诚的（Honest），无论是否合理，都构成抗辩。

特定意图犯罪

选项 C (入室盗窃 Burglary)：
Burglary 需要“意图在内实施重罪（通常是盗窃）”。被告人错误地认为打字机是自己的（事实错误）。这否定了盗窃意图 (Intent to steal)。没有特定意图，罪名不成立。

杀人罪抗辩

选项 D (谋杀 vs. 自卫)：
被告人错误地认为对方要开枪（事实错误）。这属于不完美的自卫 (Imperfect Self-Defense)。这种错误虽然不合理，但否定了谋杀罪所需的“预谋恶意” (Malice Aforethought)。结果通常是降格为任意过失杀人 (Voluntary Manslaughter)，而不是题目所控的“谋杀罪”。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

错误类型 特定意图犯罪
(如：盗窃、入室犯法、意图...)		 一般意图犯罪
(如：殴打、强奸)
事实错误 构成抗辩
(只要是真诚的，哪怕不合理)		 构成抗辩
(必须是真诚且合理的)
法律错误 通常不构成抗辩
(除非极少数例外)
解题关键：
看到题目中被告人是因为“搞错了法律规定”（如选项B中的年限）而犯错时，直接联想 Mistake of Law，这通常是一条死胡同，无法脱罪。

questions.question:
The chief executive officer (CEO) of a company that operated a knitting mill delegated all operational decision-making to the supervisor of the mill. The child labor laws in the jurisdiction provide, "It is a violation of the law for one to employ a person under the age of 17 years for full-time labor."
Without the CEO's knowledge, the supervisor hired a number of 15- and 16-year-olds to work at the mill full time. He did not ask their ages and they did not disclose them. The supervisor could have discovered their ages easily by asking for identification, but he did not do so because he was not aware of the law and believed that company policy was to hire young people.
If the statute is interpreted to create strict liability and the supervisor is charged with violating it, what is the proper verdict?

choices.a: Guilty, because he hired the children.
choices.b: Guilty, because he should have inquired as to the ages of the children.
choices.c: Not guilty, because he believed he was following company policy and was not aware of the violation.
choices.d: Not guilty, because the knitting mill, not the supervisor, is the employer of the children.

data.questionStem:
Q85108

The chief executive officer (CEO) of a company that operated a knitting mill delegated all operational decision-making to the supervisor of the mill. The child labor laws in the jurisdiction provide, "It is a violation of the law for one to employ a person under the age of 17 years for full-time labor."

Without the CEO's knowledge, the supervisor hired a number of 15- and 16-year-olds to work at the mill full time. He did not ask their ages and they did not disclose them. The supervisor could have discovered their ages easily by asking for identification, but he did not do so because he was not aware of the law and believed that company policy was to hire young people.

If the statute is interpreted to create strict liability and the supervisor is charged with violating it, what is the proper verdict?

一家经营针织厂的公司的首席执行官 (CEO) 将所有经营决策权授予了工厂主管。

该司法管辖区的童工法规定：“雇佣未满17岁者从事全职工作属于违法行为。”

在CEO不知情的情况下，主管雇佣了数名15岁和16岁的青少年在工厂全职工作。他没有询问他们的年龄，他们也没有透露。主管本可以通过要求出示身份证明轻易地发现他们的年龄，但他没有这样做，因为他不知道有这项法律，并认为公司政策就是雇佣年轻人。

如果该法规被解释为创设严格责任（strict liability），且主管被指控违反该法规，那么正确的裁决是什么？
options:
A. Guilty, because he hired the children.
有罪，因为他雇佣了这些孩子。

B. Guilty, because he should have inquired as to the ages of the children.
有罪，因为他本应询问这些孩子的年龄。

C. Not guilty, because he believed he was following company policy and was not aware of the violation.
无罪，因为他认为自己是在遵守公司政策，并且不知道自己的行为违法。

D. Not guilty, because the knitting mill, not the supervisor, is the employer of the children.
无罪，因为针织厂才是这些孩子的雇主，而不是主管。
data.explanation:
A person is guilty of any crime that he/she personally committed - even if that crime was committed on another's behalf or within the scope of employment. And guilt for a strict liability crime (as seen here) arises once a person commits the unlawful act - regardless of the person's fault or mens rea.

Here, the supervisor - who had all operational decision-making authority for the knitting mill - hired 15- and 16-year-olds for full-time labor at the mill. And though the mill is the children's employer, the supervisor personally violated the child labor statute when he hired them. Therefore, he is guilty of this strict liability crime (Choice D).

(Choice B) Though inquiring into the children's ages before hiring them would have been prudent, failing to do so is not a violation of the statute or a basis for the supervisor's guilt.

(Choice C) Evidence that the supervisor believed he was following company policy (mistake of fact) and was not aware of the violation (mistake of law) goes to the supervisor's mens rea. But since a defendant's mens rea is irrelevant to strict liability crimes, these mistakes are no defense.

Educational objective: A person is liable for any crime that he/she commits personally - even while acting on another's behalf or within the scope of employment.

选项正确率统计：A选项 84%（正确选项），B选项 4%，C选项 2%，D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一个人对其亲自实施的任何犯罪行为都负有刑事责任（有罪）——即使该犯罪是代表他人或在职务范围内实施的。对于严格责任犯罪（strict liability crime）（如此处所示），一旦行为人实施了违法行为，罪责即告成立——无论其是否存在过错或犯罪意图（mens rea）。

在本案中，拥有针织厂全部经营决策权的主管，雇佣了15岁和16岁的青少年在工厂全职工作。尽管针织厂是这些孩子的雇主，但主管在雇佣他们时亲自违反了童工法规。因此，他构成了这项严格责任犯罪，这反驳了选项D。

关于选项B：尽管在雇佣前询问孩子的年龄是审慎的做法，但不这样做本身并不构成对法规的违反，也不是主管罪责的基础。

关于选项C：主管认为其在遵守公司政策（事实错误）以及他不知道其行为违法（法律错误）的证据，都与主管的犯罪意图（mens rea）有关。但由于被告的犯罪意图与严格责任犯罪无关，这些错误不能作为抗辩理由。

教学目标：个人应对其亲自实施的任何犯罪行为负责——即使是在代表他人或在职务范围内行事。

MBE 考点解析

刑法：严格责任与代理人责任
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (Legal Rule)

1. 严格责任 (Strict Liability)： 此类犯罪不需要证明犯罪意图 (Mens Rea)。只要实施了被禁止的行为 (Actus Reus)，无论被告是否知情或有过失，均构成犯罪。

2. 个人责任 (Personal Liability)： 即使是代表雇主或在工作范围内行事，个人仍需对自己实施的犯罪行为负责。

✅ 正确答案解析 (Option A)

答案：有罪，因为他雇佣了这些孩子。

本题的关键在于题目明确指出该法规被解释为严格责任 (Strict Liability)。

  • 行为即犯罪： 在严格责任犯罪中，检方只需证明被告实施了被禁止的行为（雇佣未满17岁者）。
  • 意图无关： 主管是否知道法律、是否知道孩子年龄、是否认为自己在遵守公司政策，在法律上都是无关紧要的。
  • 亲自实施： 虽然他是为主管（Agent），但他亲自完成了“雇佣”这一违法行为。刑法惩罚的是实施行为的人。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 B “因为他本应询问……”

这是过失 (Negligence) 标准。如果选这项，意味着如果他询问了但被假证件骗了就无罪。但在严格责任下，即使他尽了最大努力去核实年龄，只要结果是雇佣了童工，他依然有罪。选项A比B更准确地描述了严格责任的本质。

选项 C “因为他不知情/遵守政策……”

这涉及犯罪意图 (Mens Rea) 的抗辩（如事实认识错误或法律认识错误）。对于严格责任犯罪，"我不知道"或"我不是故意的"不是有效的辩护理由。

选项 D “因为工厂才是雇主……”

这是民法中的雇主替代责任 (Respondeat Superior) 概念的混淆。在刑法中，公司可能因员工行为承担责任，但这并不免除实施犯罪行为的员工个人的刑事责任。主管是实际实施违法行为（雇佣）的人，必须承担个人责任。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

当题目中出现 "Strict Liability" (严格责任) 字样时：
  1. 立即划掉所有关于被告“意图”、“认知”、“善意”或“疏忽”的选项。
  2. 寻找那个简单陈述“他做了该行为” (He did the act) 的选项。
  3. 不要被“他是替老板打工”这类借口迷惑，刑法上每个人都要对自己的行为负责。

A fan and his friend were watching a football game at the fan's home when they began to argue. The friend became abusive, and the fan asked him to leave. The friend refused, walked into the kitchen, picked up a knife, and said he would cut the fan's heart out. The fan pulled a gun from under the sofa, walked to his front door, opened it, and again told the friend to leave. The friend again refused. Instead, he walked slowly toward the fan, brandishing the knife in a threatening manner. The fan, rather than running out the door himself, shot in the friend's direction, intending only to scare him. However, the bullet struck the friend, killing him instantly.
The fan is charged with murder.
Should he be convicted?

choices.a: No, because he did not intend to kill his friend.
choices.b: No, because he was acting in self-defense and had no duty to retreat.
choices.c: Yes, because he had a clear opportunity and duty to retreat.
choices.d: Yes, because the use of deadly force was unreasonable under the circumstances.

Should he be convicted?

一名球迷和他的朋友在该球迷家中观看一场橄榄球比赛时开始争吵。朋友开始辱骂，球迷要求他离开。朋友拒绝了，并走进厨房，拿起一把刀，说要挖出球迷的心脏。球迷从沙发下拔出一把枪，走到前门，打开门，再次要求朋友离开。朋友再次拒绝。相反，他以威胁的方式挥舞着刀，缓缓走向球迷。球迷没有自己跑出门，而是朝朋友的方向开了一枪，意图只是吓唬他。然而，子弹击中了朋友，致其当场死亡。

该球迷被控谋杀罪。

他是否应被定罪？
options:
A. No, because he did not intend to kill his friend.
不应定罪，因为他无意杀死他的朋友。

B. No, because he was acting in self-defense and had no duty to retreat.
不应定罪，因为他是在进行正当防卫，并且没有退让义务。

C. Yes, because he had a clear opportunity and duty to retreat.
应该定罪，因为他有明确的退让机会和退让义务。

D. Yes, because the use of deadly force was unreasonable under the circumstances.
应该定罪，因为在这种情况下使用致命武力是不合理的。
data.explanation:
Self-defense


(justification for criminal conduct)General requirementsDuty to retreat
Nondeadly force
  • Actual & reasonable belief of imminent unlawful harm
  • Force reasonably necessary to prevent harm
  • Not initial aggressor
No duty to retreat
Deadly force
  • Actual & reasonable belief of imminent seriousharm or death
  • Deadly force necessary to prevent harm
  • Not initial aggressor
  • Majority rule: No duty to retreat
  • Minority rule: Duty when safe retreat available unless inside one's home
Murder requires proof that a person unlawfully killed another with malice aforethought. But the use of deadly force in self-defense justifies a killing and serves as a defense to murder if the person:

  • actually and reasonably believed that such force was necessary to prevent imminent serious bodily harm or death and
  • was not the initial aggressor - ie, did not engage in physical force first or intentionally provoke the altercation.


Under the majority rule, there is no duty to retreat before using deadly force in self-defense. And though a minority of jurisdictions require retreat before using deadly force if it is safe to do so, a person never has a duty to retreat in his/her own home.

Here, the fan shot and killed his friend. But the fan actually and reasonably believed that he needed to use deadly force in self-defense because (1) the friend had threatened to cut out the fan's heart and (2) was walking toward him while brandishing a knife. Additionally, the fan was not the initial aggressor, so he justifiably shot his friend in self-defense (Choice D). And though the fan had a clear opportunity to run out the open front door, he had no duty to retreat since he was in his own home (Choice C). Therefore, the fan should not be convicted of murder.

(Choice A) A person may be convicted of murder - even if there was no intent to kill - if the person recklessly disregarded a high risk of serious bodily harm or death (ie, depraved-heart murder). Since the fan recklessly disregarded the high risk that the fired bullet would hit and kill the friend, the fan's lack of intent to kill will not prevent his conviction.

Educational objective: Deadly force can be used in self-defense when a person (1) actually and reasonably believes that such force is necessary to prevent imminent serious harm or death and (2) is not the initial aggressor. There is generally no duty to retreat before using such force - especially when a person is inside his/her home.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 86%（正确选项），C选项 2%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

正当防卫


(为犯罪行为提供的正当理由)一般要求退让义务
非致命武力
  • 对即将发生的非法伤害有真实且合理的相信
  • 为防止伤害而合理必要的武力
  • 非初始攻击者
无退让义务
致命武力
  • 对即将发生的严重伤害或死亡有真实且合理的相信
  • 为防止伤害所必需的致命武力
  • 非初始攻击者
  • 多数派规则：无退让义务
  • 少数派规则：当存在安全退让途径时有退让义务，除非身处自己家中
谋杀罪要求证明行为人怀有预谋恶意非法杀害他人。但是，如果行为人符合以下条件，在正当防卫中使用致命武力可为杀人行为提供正当理由，并可作为对谋杀罪的抗辩：

  • 真实且合理地相信使用此等武力对于防止即将发生的严重身体伤害或死亡是必要的，并且
  • 不是初始攻击者——即没有首先使用肢体暴力或故意挑起争端。


根据多数派规则，在使用致命武力进行正当防卫前没有退让义务。尽管少数司法管辖区要求在可以安全退让的情况下，使用致命武力前必须退让，但一个人在自己家中绝无退让义务。

在本案中，球迷开枪杀死了他的朋友。但球迷真实且合理地相信，他需要使用致命武力进行正当防卫，因为 (1) 朋友曾威胁要挖出他的心脏，并且 (2) 当时正挥舞着刀向他走来。此外，该球迷并非初始攻击者，因此他为正当防卫而向其朋友开枪是具有正当理由的(选项 D)。而且，尽管该球迷有明确的机会从敞开的前门跑出去，但由于他身在自己家中，他没有退让的义务(选项 C)。因此，该球迷不应被判犯有谋杀罪。

(选项 A) 一个人即使没有杀人意图，也可能被判犯有谋杀罪——如果该人鲁莽地漠视造成严重身体伤害或死亡的高度风险（即“堕落心智谋杀”，depraved-heart murder）。由于该球迷鲁莽地漠视了射出的子弹会击中并杀死朋友的高度风险，他缺乏杀人意图这一点并不能使其免于被定罪。

教学目标：在以下情况下，可在正当防卫中使用致命武力：(1) 行为人真实且合理地相信，此等武力对于防止即将发生的严重伤害或死亡是必要的，且 (2) 行为人并非初始攻击者。在使用此等武力前，通常没有退让的义务——尤其是当行为人身处自己家中时。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

刑法：正当防卫与城堡法则
🔑 核心法律规则 (Legal Rule)

正当防卫 (Self-Defense)：当被告人合理相信必须使用武力以防止迫在眉睫的非法伤害时，其行为是正当的。

致命武力 (Deadly Force)：仅在面临死亡或严重身体伤害 (Great Bodily Harm) 的威胁时才可使用。

退让义务 (Duty to Retreat)：

  • 多数派规则：无退让义务，可坚守阵地 (Stand Your Ground)。
  • 少数派规则：若能安全撤退，则必须撤退。
  • 例外 - 城堡法则 (Castle Doctrine)：即使在要求退让的司法管辖区，一个人在自己家中 (Home) 遭受攻击时，也绝无退让义务。

⚖️ 案情逻辑推演

本案的关键在于判断被告（球迷）开枪是否构成合法的正当防卫。

  1. 威胁的性质：朋友手持刀具，扬言要“挖出心脏”，并挥舞刀具逼近。这构成了迫在眉睫的致命威胁 (Imminent Deadly Threat)。
  2. 武力的对等性：面对致命威胁（刀），使用致命武力（枪）通常被视为合理的。
  3. 退让问题：虽然前门大开，球迷有机会逃跑，但事件发生在球迷家中。根据城堡法则，他没有义务逃跑，有权使用致命武力自卫。

📝 选项深度解析

选项 B (正确) 不应定罪，因为他是正当防卫且无退让义务。

这是最佳答案。它直接击中了本题的两个核心：(1) 面对持刀威胁使用枪支符合正当防卫的要件；(2) 即使有逃跑机会，因为身处家中 (Castle Doctrine)，法律赋予他不退让的特权。

选项 A (错误) 不应定罪，因为他无意杀死朋友。

这是一个极具迷惑性的干扰项。
❌ 错误原因：谋杀罪不仅包含“蓄意杀人” (Intent to kill)，还包含“堕落心智谋杀” (Depraved Heart Murder)，即对人命极其鲁莽的漠视。朝人开枪（即使只是想吓唬）通常构成这种鲁莽。如果不是因为正当防卫 (Justification)，球迷的行为足以构成谋杀。因此，让他脱罪的不是“缺乏意图”，而是“正当防卫”。

选项 C (错误) 应定罪，因为他有明确的退让机会。

❌ 错误原因：这忽略了城堡法则 (Castle Doctrine)。虽然普通法中的少数派规则要求退让，但这一义务从未延伸到一个人的家中。家是最后的庇护所。

选项 D (错误) 应定罪，因为使用致命武力不合理。

❌ 错误原因：面对挥舞刀具并发出死亡威胁的攻击者，使用枪支被视为成比例的 (Proportional) 反应。并没有要求防卫者必须使用完全相同的武器，只要武力级别（致命 vs. 致命）相当即可。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

当题目中出现"Home" (家) 这个地点要素，且涉及自卫情节时，立刻联想 Castle Doctrine (城堡法则)。

此外，注意区分Justification (正当理由) 和 Mens Rea (犯罪意图)。如果行为是正当的（如自卫），那么意图（想杀人还是想吓人）通常就不再重要了。优先选择基于“正当理由”的选项，而不是基于“缺乏意图”的选项。

questions.question:
An off-duty doctor was jogging one evening when he came upon an elderly woman who had suffered a severe heart attack while walking her dogs. The woman was not breathing, and the doctor could barely detect a pulse. The doctor immediately began CPR on the woman while a bystander called 911. The doctor was able to resuscitate the woman but, in the process of performing CPR, broke several of her ribs. The broken ribs punctured the woman's lungs, causing them to collapse and leaving her unable to breathe. Because the doctor did not have the necessary medical instruments to release the air that was trapped inside of the woman's lungs, the doctor did nothing further to help her. The woman subsequently died from suffocation before an ambulance arrived.
Is the doctor criminally liable for the woman's death?

choices.a: No, because it was not reasonably possible for the doctor to help the woman.
choices.b: No, because the doctor was not under a legal duty to help the woman.
choices.c: Yes, because the doctor, as a medical professional, was under a legal duty to help the woman.
choices.d: Yes, because the doctor stopped rendering aid to the woman after breaking her ribs.

Q85112

An off-duty doctor was jogging one evening when he came upon an elderly woman who had suffered a severe heart attack while walking her dogs. The woman was not breathing, and the doctor could barely detect a pulse. The doctor immediately began CPR on the woman while a bystander called 911. The doctor was able to resuscitate the woman but, in the process of performing CPR, broke several of her ribs. The broken ribs punctured the woman's lungs, causing them to collapse and leaving her unable to breathe. Because the doctor did not have the necessary medical instruments to release the air that was trapped inside of the woman's lungs, the doctor did nothing further to help her. The woman subsequently died from suffocation before an ambulance arrived.

Is the doctor criminally liable for the woman's death?

一天晚上，一位不当班的医生在慢跑时，遇到了一位在遛狗时突发严重心脏病的老年妇女。该妇女已经停止呼吸，医生几乎检测不到她的脉搏。在一名旁观者拨打911的同时，医生立即开始对该妇女进行心肺复苏术（CPR）。医生成功地使该妇女苏醒，但在进行心肺复苏术的过程中，压断了她的几根肋骨。断裂的肋骨刺穿了该妇女的肺部，导致肺部塌陷，使其无法呼吸。由于医生没有必要的医疗器械来排出困在该妇女肺部的空气，因此他没有采取进一步的措施来帮助她。该妇女随后在救护车到达前因窒息死亡。

该医生对该妇女的死亡是否负有刑事责任？
options:
A. No, because it was not reasonably possible for the doctor to help the woman.
否，因为医生在合理情况下不可能帮助该妇女。

B. No, because the doctor was not under a legal duty to help the woman.
否，因为医生没有法律义务去帮助该妇女。

C. Yes, because the doctor, as a medical professional, was under a legal duty to help the woman.
是，因为该医生作为一名医疗专业人员，有法律义务帮助该妇女。

D. Yes, because the doctor stopped rendering aid to the woman after breaking her ribs.
是，因为医生在压断该妇女的肋骨后停止了提供救助。
data.explanation:
Legal duty to act


(subject to criminal liability if breach)
Special relationshipParent/child, spouses, employer/employee
Assumption of careOnce person renders aid, liable for making victim's condition worse (ie, detrimental undertaking)
Created risk of harmPerson who falsely imprisons another & fails to provide food is liable for resulting death
Statute imposes duty"Off-duty nurses must render aid to injured persons"
Contract imposes duty"Employer will administer first aid in case of emergency"
Mnemonic: Specific Acts Can Spawn Crimes

Criminal liability can arise from a failure to act (ie, an omission) if the defendant:
  • had a legal duty to act and
  • could have reasonably done so.

A legal duty to act is imposed when a person voluntarily assumes care of another - eg, by rendering aid in a medical emergency. As a result, a voluntary rescuer has a duty to take all reasonable steps to provide care to the rescuee and may be criminally liable for omissions during the process. But such omissions will not result in criminal liability if the omitted action could not reasonably be performed.

Here, by rendering aid after finding the woman unconscious, the doctor voluntarily assumed a legal duty to take all reasonable steps to help her (Choice B). However, he subsequently failed to relieve the pressure in the woman's lungs caused by his administration of necessary CPR. But since the doctor lacked the medical equipment necessary to do so, it was not reasonably possible for him to perform the omitted act. Therefore, he is not criminally liable for the woman's death (Choice D).

(Choice C) The doctor was not under a legal duty to help the woman simply because he was a medical professional. Instead, his duty to act on the woman's behalf was imposed when he voluntarily assumed care of the woman by rendering aid.

Educational objective: Criminal liability can arise from a failure to act if the defendant had a legal duty to act (eg, by voluntarily assuming care of another) and could have reasonably done so. However, omissions in performing that duty will not result in criminal liability if the omitted action could not reasonably be performed.

选项正确率统计：A选项 45%（正确选项），B选项 12%，C选项 2%，D选项 40%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

作为的法律义务


（如违反，须承担刑事责任）
特殊关系父母/子女、配偶、雇主/雇员
自愿承担照护一旦开始提供救助，若使受害者状况恶化，则需承担责任（即，有害的承担）
创造了伤害风险非法监禁他人且未能提供食物者，对由此导致的死亡负责
法规施加的义务“不当班的护士必须向受伤人员提供救助”
合同施加的义务“雇主在紧急情况下将提供急救”
助记法: Specific Acts Can Spawn Crimes

如果被告：
  • 负有作为的法律义务并且
  • 在合理情况下本可以履行该义务，
其刑事责任可因不作为（即疏忽）而产生。

当一个人自愿承担对他人的照护时——例如，在医疗紧急情况下提供救助——就产生了作为的法律义务。因此，自愿施救者有义务采取一切合理步骤向被救者提供照护，并可能因在此过程中的疏忽而承担刑事责任。但是，如果被疏忽的行为在合理情况下无法履行，则此等疏忽不会导致刑事责任。

在本案中，医生在发现该妇女昏迷后提供了救助，从而自愿承担了采取一切合理步骤帮助她的法律义务（选项B）。然而，他随后未能解除因实施必要的心肺复苏术而造成的该妇女肺部压力。但由于医生缺乏这样做所必需的医疗设备，他在合理情况下不可能履行这一被疏忽的行为。因此，他对该妇女的死亡不负刑事责任（选项D）。

（选项C）医生并非仅仅因为其医疗专业人员的身份而负有帮助该妇女的法律义务。相反，他的作为义务是在他通过提供救助自愿承担对该妇女的照护时产生的。

教学目标：如果被告负有作为的法律义务（例如，通过自愿承担对他人的照护），并且在合理情况下本可以履行该义务，那么刑事责任可因不作为而产生。但是，如果在履行该义务过程中的疏忽行为在合理情况下无法履行，则该疏忽不会导致刑事责任。

MBE 刑法考点解析

Criminal Liability Omission Duty to Act
正确答案：A
否，因为医生在合理情况下不可能帮助该妇女。
(No, because it was not reasonably possible for the doctor to help the woman.)

核心法律规则 (Legal Rule)

在刑法中，刑事责任通常基于“作为”(Act)，但在特定情况下，“不作为” (Omission) 也可能构成犯罪。构成不作为犯罪必须同时满足以下三个条件：

  • 法律义务 (Legal Duty)： 被告必须负有行动的法律义务。
  • 知情 (Knowledge)： 被告必须知道产生该义务的事实情况。
  • 能力 (Ability to Act)： 被告必须在合理可能 (Reasonably Possible) 的情况下有能力履行该行为。

案情深度解析

1. 义务的产生 (Creation of Duty)
普通法原则是“无义务救助陌生人”。但是，一旦医生自愿开始救助 (Voluntary Assumption of Care)，他就产生了一项法律义务：必须采取合理的步骤继续救助，不能让受害者处于更糟糕的境地。
结论：医生确实有法律义务（这排除了选项B）。
2. 义务的履行与限制 (Scope & Limit)
虽然医生有义务，但法律并不强人所难。刑事责任的前提是医生“能够”提供帮助。
在本案中，医生虽然造成了气胸（作为CPR的并发症），但他缺乏必要的医疗器械来处理这一并发症。
3. 结论 (Conclusion)
由于缺乏设备，医生在物理上无法 (Impossibility) 履行排出肺部空气的行为。既然“做不到”，法律就不会因其“没做”而惩罚他。

选项陷阱分析

选项 B 错误： 声称医生“没有法律义务”。这是错误的。一旦他开始CPR，他就通过自愿承担 (Assumption of Care) 产生了义务。如果他有设备却故意不救，他就可能承担责任。他免责的原因不是“没义务”，而是“没能力”。
选项 C 错误： 声称医生因“专业身份”而有义务。在普通法下，医生在下班时间对陌生人没有自动的救助义务（除非有特定的“好撒玛利亚人”法规，但MBE题目默认考普通法原则）。
选项 D 错误： 声称因“停止救助”而负责。停止救助本身不构成犯罪，前提是继续救助在客观上是不可能的。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
在处理 Omission (不作为) 题目时，请按顺序检查：
  1. 是否存在法律义务？(Statute, Contract, Relationship, Assumption of Care, Peril Created)
  2. 被告是否有能力履行该义务？(Ability to Act)
本题的考点在于第二步：没有能力 = 没有刑事责任。

questions.question:
A man who believed that his wife was cheating on him with her gym trainer decided to kill the trainer. He loaded his handgun and set off for the trainer's house. Because he was anxious about committing the crime, the man first stopped at a bar, drank eight shots of hard liquor, and became intoxicated. He then left the bar and went to the trainer's house. When the trainer answered the door, the man shot and killed him. The man then passed out on the trainer's porch.
The man has been charged with murder in a jurisdiction that follows the common law.
Can the man raise an intoxication defense?

choices.a: No, because drinking at the bar was the proximate cause of the killing.
choices.b: No, because the man intended to commit the murder and drank to strengthen his nerve.
choices.c: Yes, because drinking at the bar was a foreseeable intervening cause of the killing.
choices.d: Yes, because the man's intoxication negated the specific intent required for murder.

data.questionStem:
Q84805 A man who believed that his wife was cheating on him with her gym trainer decided to kill the trainer. He loaded his handgun and set off for the trainer's house. Because he was anxious about committing the crime, the man first stopped at a bar, drank eight shots of hard liquor, and became intoxicated. He then left the bar and went to the trainer's house. When the trainer answered the door, the man shot and killed him. The man then passed out on the trainer's porch.

The man has been charged with murder in a jurisdiction that follows the common law.

Can the man raise an intoxication defense? 一名男子认为他的妻子与她的健身教练有染，于是决定杀死该教练。他给手枪装上子弹，然后前往教练的家。由于对犯罪感到焦虑，该男子先在一家酒吧停下，喝了八杯烈酒，然后陷入醉酒状态。随后他离开酒吧，前往教练的家。当教练开门时，该男子开枪将其杀死。该男子随后在教练的门廊上昏倒。

在一个遵循普通法的司法管辖区，该男子被指控犯有谋杀罪。

该男子能否提出醉酒抗辩？
options:
A. No, because drinking at the bar was the proximate cause of the killing.
不可以，因为在酒吧喝酒是这起杀人案的近因。

B. No, because the man intended to commit the murder and drank to strengthen his nerve.
不可以，因为该男子意图实施谋杀，并且喝酒是为了壮胆。

C. Yes, because drinking at the bar was a foreseeable intervening cause of the killing.
可以，因为在酒吧喝酒是这起杀人案中一个可预见的介入原因。

D. Yes, because the man's intoxication negated the specific intent required for murder.
可以，因为该男子的醉酒状态排除了谋杀罪所要求的特定意图。
data.explanation:
A defendant may be able to raise an intoxication defense if he/she was intoxicated when the crime was committed due to either:

Involuntary intoxication – the unknowing or forcible ingestion of an intoxicating substance is a defense if it placed the defendant in the same mental state required for an insanity defense.

Voluntary intoxication – the deliberate ingestion of a substance that the defendant knew or should have known has intoxicating effects is only a defense to specific intent crimes if the intoxication prevented the defendant from forming such intent.

At common law, murder is defined as the unlawful killing of another with malice aforethought. Although voluntary intoxication is no defense if the defendant acted with reckless malice aforethought, it may negate a defendant's specific intent to kill. But such intent is not negated if the defendant became intoxicated to commit the crime.

Here, the man decided to kill the trainer because he thought that the trainer and his wife were having an affair (specific intent to kill). He had deliberately ingested eight shots of hard liquor at a bar before he went to the trainer's house (voluntary intoxication) and therefore was intoxicated when he killed the trainer. But since the man had become intoxicated to strengthen his nerve to commit the murder, intoxication is no defense (Choice D).

(Choice A) Proximate causation exists when it was foreseeable that the defendant's conduct would kill the victim. Although common law murder requires proof that the defendant proximately caused the victim's death, it has no bearing on whether intoxication is a valid defense.

(Choice C) An unforeseeable intervening cause—an event that happens after the defendant acts but before harm occurs-may eliminate the proximate causation required for a crime. But a foreseeable intervening cause will not. And even if an unforeseeable intervening cause had occurred (eg, had a plane crashed into the trainer's home), it would not impact the man's ability to raise an intoxication defense. Instead, it would serve as a separate defense.

Educational objective: Involuntary intoxication is a defense if it placed the defendant in the same mental state required for an insanity defense. Voluntary intoxication is a defense to specific intent crimes if the intoxication kept the defendant from forming such intent. But it is not a defense if the defendant became intoxicated to commit the crime.

Intoxication defense


Type of crimeDefinitionVoluntaryInvoluntary
Specific intentAct consciously performed for particular purpose✓✓
General intentAct consciously performed✓
Strict liabilityAct performed✓




如果被告人在犯罪时因以下任一原因处于醉酒状态，则可以提出醉酒抗辩：

非自愿醉酒——在不知情或被强迫的情况下摄入致醉物质，如果这使被告人处于精神错乱抗辩所需的精神状态，则可以作为抗辩理由。

自愿醉酒——故意摄入被告人知道或应该知道具有致醉效果的物质，只有当醉酒状态阻止了被告人形成该意图时，才可作为特定意图犯罪的抗辩理由。

在普通法中，谋杀罪被定义为带有预谋恶意地非法杀害他人。尽管如果被告人是出于轻率的预谋恶意而行为，自愿醉酒不能作为抗辩理由，但它可能会排除被告人杀人的特定意图。但是，如果被告人是为了犯罪而醉酒，则该意图不会被排除。

在本案中，该男子因为认为教练与他的妻子有染而决定杀死教练（杀人的特定意图）。他在去教练家之前，在酒吧故意喝了八杯烈酒（自愿醉酒），因此在杀死教练时处于醉酒状态。但是，由于该男子是为了壮胆实施谋杀而醉酒，因此醉酒不能作为抗辩理由（选项 D）。

（选项 A）当可以预见到被告人的行为会导致受害人死亡时，就存在近因。尽管普通法上的谋杀罪要求证明被告人是受害人死亡的近因，但这与醉酒是否为有效抗辩无关。

（选项 C）一个不可预见的介入原因——即在被告人行为之后、损害发生之前发生的事件——可能会排除犯罪所要求的近因。但一个可预见的介入原因则不会。而且，即使发生了不可预见的介入原因（例如，一架飞机撞入教练的家），也不会影响该男子提出醉酒抗辩的能力。相反，它会成为一个独立的抗辩理由。

教学目标： 如果非自愿醉酒使被告人处于精神错乱抗辩所需的精神状态，则可以作为抗辩理由。如果自愿醉酒使被告人无法形成特定意图，则可以作为特定意图犯罪的抗辩理由。但是，如果被告人是为了犯罪而醉酒，则不能作为抗辩理由。

醉酒抗辩

一般意图有意识地实施的行为✓

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Voluntary Intoxication & Specific Intent
📚 核心规则 (General Rule)

自愿醉酒 (Voluntary Intoxication) 通常只能作为特定意图犯罪 (Specific Intent Crimes) 的抗辩理由。

如果醉酒程度严重到使被告人无法形成犯罪所需的特定意图（如“意图杀人”或“意图盗窃”），则可以否定该意图。

⚠️ 关键例外 (The Exception)

"Liquid Courage"（借酒壮胆）原则：

如果被告人在清醒时就已经形成了犯罪意图（Formed Intent），然后为了壮胆（Strengthen Nerve）去实施犯罪而故意喝酒，那么醉酒不能作为抗辩理由。

本案事实分析 (Fact Pattern Analysis)

第一步：形成意图 (Intent Formed)
男子在清醒状态下决定杀死教练。
Specific Intent 已确立
第二步：准备工具
给手枪装弹，前往教练家。
第三步：自愿醉酒 (Intoxication)
因为焦虑，去酒吧喝了8杯烈酒。
目的：为了实施已计划好的犯罪。
第四步：实施犯罪 (Actus Reus)
醉酒状态下开枪杀人。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 B)

"No, because the man intended to commit the murder and drank to strengthen his nerve."

虽然谋杀（一级谋杀/Common Law Murder）通常包含特定意图（Specific Intent to kill），且自愿醉酒通常可以否定这种意图，但本案触发了例外情况。

因为意图是在醉酒之前就已经完全形成的，醉酒只是为了促进犯罪的实施。法律不允许被告人利用自己制造的醉酒状态来逃避早已策划好的犯罪责任。

❌ 为什么选项 D 错误？

选项 D 机械地套用了“醉酒可以否定特定意图”的一般规则，却忽略了本案中意图形成的时间点。如果男子是在醉酒后才突然产生杀人念头，D 可能是对的。但在本案中，意图先于醉酒存在。

❌ 为什么选项 A 错误？

选项 A 讨论的是近因 (Proximate Cause)。虽然因果关系是犯罪构成的要素，但这里的核心争议点是精神状态 (Mens Rea)，而不是因果关系。喝酒并不是杀人的法律近因，男子的开枪行为才是。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Intoxication Defense 题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 看罪名：是 Specific Intent（如谋杀、盗窃、抢劫）吗？如果是 General Intent（如殴打、强奸），自愿醉酒直接无效。
  2. 看时间：如果是 Specific Intent，检查意图是何时形成的。如果是先有预谋，后喝酒壮胆，则醉酒抗辩无效。
© MBE Criminal Law Study Guide

questions.question: In which of the following situations is the defendant most likely to be convicted, even though he did not intend to bring about the harm that the statute defining the offense is designed to prevent?

choices.a: The defendant burglarized a jewelry store, intending to steal some diamonds. As he entered the store, he short-circuited the store's burglar alarm system, thereby preventing a warning of his entry to police. The smoldering wires eventually caused a fire that destroyed the store. Defendant is charged with arson.
choices.b: The defendant struck the victim in the face with a baseball bat, intending to inflict a serious injury. The victim died after being hospitalized for three days. The defendant is charged with murder.
choices.c: The defendant wanted to frighten the victim's friend by placing a plastic rattlesnake in his lunch box. When the victim mistakenly took the lunch box and opened it, believing it to be his own, the plastic rattlesnake popped out. As a result of the fright, the victim suffered a heart attack and died. The defendant is charged with involuntary manslaughter.
choices.d: The defendant was the president of an aspirin manufacturing company. A federal inspector discovered that a large number of aspirin tablets randomly scattered through several bottles in a carton ready for shipment were laced with arsenic. The defendant is charged with attempted introduction of adulterated drugs into interstate commerce.

data.questionStem:
Q85094

In which of the following situations is the defendant most likely to be convicted, even though he did not intend to bring about the harm that the statute defining the offense is designed to prevent?

在下列哪种情况下，即使被告无意造成界定该罪行的法规旨在防止的损害，他最有可能被定罪？
options:
A. The defendant burglarized a jewelry store, intending to steal some diamonds. As he entered the store, he short-circuited the store's burglar alarm system, thereby preventing a warning of his entry to police. The smoldering wires eventually caused a fire that destroyed the store. Defendant is charged with arson.
被告对一家珠宝店实施了入室犯法罪 (burglary)，意图盗窃一些钻石。在他进入商店时，他使商店的防盗警报系统短路，从而阻止了警方接到他进入的警报。闷燃的电线最终引发火灾，烧毁了商店。被告被控犯有纵火罪。

B. The defendant struck the victim in the face with a baseball bat, intending to inflict a serious injury. The victim died after being hospitalized for three days. The defendant is charged with murder.
被告用棒球棒击打受害人面部，意图造成严重伤害。受害人住院三天后死亡。被告被控犯有谋杀罪。

C. The defendant wanted to frighten the victim's friend by placing a plastic rattlesnake in his lunch box. When the victim mistakenly took the lunch box and opened it, believing it to be his own, the plastic rattlesnake popped out. As a result of the fright, the victim suffered a heart attack and died. The defendant is charged with involuntary manslaughter.
被告想通过将一条塑料响尾蛇放入受害人朋友的午餐盒中来吓唬他。当受害人误拿了那个午餐盒并打开，以为是自己的时，塑料响尾蛇弹了出来。由于受到惊吓，受害人心脏病发作死亡。被告被控犯有非自愿过失杀人罪。

D. The defendant was the president of an aspirin manufacturing company. A federal inspector discovered that a large number of aspirin tablets randomly scattered through several bottles in a carton ready for shipment were laced with arsenic. The defendant is charged with attempted introduction of adulterated drugs into interstate commerce.
被告是一家阿司匹林制造公司的总裁。一名联邦检查员发现，在一个准备装运的纸箱中的几个瓶子里，随机散布着大量阿司匹林药片被掺入了砷。被告被控试图将掺假药品引入州际贸易罪。
data.explanation:
Homicide


Common lawModern approach
MurderUnlawful killing committed with malice aforethought:
  • Intent to kill
  • Intent to cause serious bodily harm
  • Depraved-heart murder
  • Felony murder
First-degree: murder committed with:
  • premeditation & deliberation
  • heinous acts (eg, bombing, torture)
  • enumerated felony murder
Second-degree: any murder that is not first-degree murder
Voluntary manslaughterIntentional killing mitigated by either:
  • adequate provocation (ie, heat of passion)
  • other mitigating factors (eg, imperfect self-defense)
Involuntary manslaughterUnintentional killing either:
  • caused by criminal negligence (or recklessness under MPC)
  • occurs during commission of criminal act (eg, misdemeanor manslaughter)
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Murder is an unlawful killing committed with malice aforethought. The malice-aforethought requirement can be satisfied by any of these mental states:
  • intent to kill
  • intent to inflict serious bodily injury
  • reckless disregard of an obvious or unjustifiably high risk of causing death or serious bodily injury (ie, depraved-heart murder) or
  • intent to commit an inherently dangerous felony (ie, felony-murder rule).
Here, the defendant intended to inflict a serious injury when he struck the victim in the face with a baseball bat. And since the victim died as a result, the defendant is guilty of murder - even though he did not intend to kill the victim. Therefore, this defendant is most likely to be convicted of the charged offense.

(Choice A) Arson is the malicious (ie, intentional or reckless) burning of any structure. But this defendant did not intend to burn the store. Nor did he recklessly disregard an obvious or high risk that disabling the store's burglary alarm would result in a fire. Therefore, he is unlikely to be convicted of arson.

(Choice C) Involuntary manslaughter is an unintentional killing committed with criminal negligence or during an unlawful act. But this defendant is unlikely to be convicted of this crime since he did not gross deviate from a reasonable standard of care, or commit an unlawful act, by pranking the victim with a plastic rattlesnake.

(Choice D) Attempt always requires proof of specific intent to commit the target crime. And since there is no indication that this defendant intended to introduce adulterated aspirin into interstate commerce, he is unlikely to be convicted of attempt. This is true even though the completed crime is likely a strict liability offense.

Educational objective: Murder need not be committed with the intent to kill. Instead, this crime can be committed with any type of malice aforethought - eg, intent to inflict serious bodily injury.

选项正确率统计：A选项 14%，B选项 65%（正确选项），C选项 8%，D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

杀人罪


Common law现代做法
谋杀罪怀有预谋恶意实施的非法杀人行为：
  • 杀人意图
  • 造成严重身体伤害的意图
  • 堕落心态谋杀 (Depraved-heart murder)
  • 重罪谋杀 (Felony murder)
一级谋杀：犯有以下情形的谋杀：
  • 预谋与策划
  • 令人发指的行为（例如，爆炸、酷刑）
  • 列举的重罪谋杀
二级谋杀：任何非一级谋杀的谋杀罪
自愿过失杀人罪因以下任一情况而减轻的故意杀人：
  • 充分的挑衅（即，激情杀人）
  • 其他减轻处罚的情节（例如，不完善的自卫）
非自愿过失杀人罪非故意杀人，其原因为：
  • 由刑事疏忽（或根据 MPC 为鲁莽 (reckless)）引起
  • 在实施犯罪行为期间发生（例如，轻罪过失杀人）
MPC = Model Penal Code.

谋杀罪是一种怀有预谋恶意的非法杀人行为。预谋恶意的要求可以通过以下任何一种精神状态来满足：
  • 杀人意图
  • 造成严重身体伤害的意图
  • 鲁莽地 (reckless) 无视导致死亡或严重身体伤害的明显或不合理的高度风险（即，堕落心态谋杀，depraved-heart murder）或
  • 意图犯下内在危险的重罪（即，重罪谋杀规则，felony-murder rule）。
在本案中，被告用棒球棒击打受害人面部时，意图造成严重伤害。由于受害人因此死亡，被告犯有谋杀罪——尽管他无意杀死受害人。因此，该被告最有可能被判犯有所指控的罪行。

(选项 A) 纵火罪是指恶意（即，故意或鲁莽 (reckless)）焚烧任何建筑物。但本案被告无意焚烧商店。他也没有鲁莽地无视禁用商店防盗警报器会导致火灾的明显或高度风险。因此，他不大可能被判犯有纵火罪。

(选项 C) 非自愿过失杀人罪是一种因刑事疏忽或在非法行为期间实施的非故意杀人。但本案被告不大可能被判犯有此罪，因为他用塑料响尾蛇对受害人进行恶作剧的行为，并未严重偏离合理的注意标准，也未构成非法行为。

(选项 D) 未遂罪总是需要证明有实施目标犯罪的具体意图。由于没有迹象表明该被告意图将掺假阿司匹林引入州际贸易，他不大可能被判犯有未遂罪。即使已完成的罪行可能是一种严格责任罪，这一点仍然成立。

教学目标：谋杀罪不一定需要有杀人意图才能构成。相反，该罪行可以通过任何类型的预谋恶意来构成——例如，意图造成严重身体伤害。
